decisions.executionNote: Raise and start turning tools downward with small continuous increments; left will approach the basket handle first.
Track the moving basket toward its left handle side while finishing the downward approach; right arm stays clear.
Reduce approach increments after the continuity rejection; intercept the left part of the moving handle.
Continue a smaller elbow-continuous approach to the left handle shoulder; monitor basket motion and tool clearance.
Basket is drifting into the right workspace. Switch basket interception to the right arm and leave the left available for incoming objects; finish downward orientation.
Approach the basket's moving right rim from above; keep the left arm stationary and separated.
Lower around the right basket rim and close while approximately matching conveyor drift; retention remains uncertain until a lift.
Test right-rim retention with a 9 cm upward motion and slight retraction, keeping the gripper closed.
Basket visibly follows the closed right gripper. Add lift clearance and bring it inward without crossing; left approaches incoming conveyor objects for inspection.
Hold the visibly retained basket elevated. Move the left tool toward the incoming light-colored item while maintaining elbow-up continuity.
Align the open left gripper with the cream-and-brown object that resembles the board image; approach at belt pickup height while right holds the basket.
Back off slightly from the left reach limit and let the cream object enter the open jaws; maintain basket elevation.
The cream object is now between the left fingers. Close while following drift, then make a small lift to check retention.
Retention is not evident: the cream item remains near the belt. Reopen and adjust farther along the belt depth and lower while tracking its motion, then retry closure.
The target is a cream/brown figurine. Avoid further downward pressure; shift the open jaws toward its torso, then close while matching conveyor drift.
Near the forward reach limit, tilt the left fingers toward the figurine instead of extending the elbow further; close around its body.
Lift and retract the closed left gripper to test figurine retention, keeping the already lifted basket steady.
The figurine did not lift. Its torso is farther forward than the previous grasp; approach it with open fingers and a modest forward tool tilt while tracking rightward drift.
Use the clear wrist view to center the figurine within the jaws, lower toward its torso, and close without further forward extension.
Correct slightly left and farther forward around the torso, then allow a longer closure before a small retention check. Basket remains elevated.
Wrist view shows the figurine left of the closed jaws. Reopen, offset left and slightly back, let drift center the torso, then close again.
The figurine is now centered between the fingers. Finish closure and lift/retract to verify actual retention, while maintaining the basket grip.
The figurine remained on the belt. Recenter over its new position with open fingers and approach lower; previous closures appear to have been above the body.
Figurine is centered in the wrist view. Advance slightly toward the torso and descend another 3 cm before closing, while matching conveyor motion.
The torso is now visibly enclosed by the jaws. Lift and retract the closed left gripper; bring the held basket slightly inward without crossing the arms.
The figurine now stays fixed in the left wrist view, indicating retention. Lift and retract it away from the basket wall before transferring over the opening.
The basket is swinging/tilting near the figurine. Separate the arms laterally and retract the retained figurine farther before attempting insertion.
Both objects are visibly retained. Raise the figurine above rim height and bring the suspended basket inward/back, keeping left and right wrists separated.
Translate the retained figurine above the basket's left interior, with clearance above the rim; keep both wrists on their own sides.
After the continuity stop, use smaller increments to center the figurine over the left part of the basket opening and lower toward release height.
The figurine is over the basket interior. Open the left gripper to release it, then withdraw upward and left while keeping the basket lifted.
The figurine is visibly resting inside the basket. Clear the empty left arm and add 4 cm of basket lift for margin, keeping the right grip closed.
Hold the basket steadily aloft with the figurine visibly inside; allow settling and monitor retention.
